overview: The Medford School Committee met to receive opening-of-school updates, review a new Career Technical Education honors pilot, and approve the superintendent's goals for the 2026-2027 school year.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session to discuss a grievance with the Medford Teachers Association and litigation strategy regarding Sheik, PPA versus City of Medford.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the bills, payrolls, a $10,000 donation from Watts Water Technologies, and the meeting minutes of August 24, 2026, with an amendment to include the full text of a prior resolution.

items.title: Mustang Moment
items.summary: Fourth-grade student Andrea presented her self-published children's book, which the district purchased to display in school libraries.

items.title: Honors Pilot for Career Technical Education (CTE)
items.summary: Received a presentation on the new, optional CTE honors pilot program for the 2026-27 school year, which allows juniors and seniors to earn honors credit through cooperative education or a capstone project.

items.title: Opening of Schools Update
items.summary: Reviewed updates on district-wide staffing, enrollment numbers, the reduction of the after-school program waitlist, summer professional development, and upgrades to technology security and school facilities.

items.title: Superintendent's Goals for School Year 2026-2027
items.summary: Approved Superintendent Galusi's student learning and professional practice goals for the 2026-27 school year.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences and stood for a moment of silence for Lorraine Miles, Gerald H. Wadness, and Derek McGuire.
